title: Oakwood University student selected for Obama Foundation scholarship - NewsBreak
text:
By Emily Moessner ,
1 hours ago
HUNTSVILLE, Ala. ( WHNT ) — One North Alabama college student is getting the opportunity of a lifetime, thanks to a prestigious scholarship.
“High-achiever” seems like the perfect way to describe Oakwood University senior Matthew Dormus. In addition to being heavily involved on campus and dedicated to his studies, he can also now add “ scholarship recipient ” to his resume.
Tuesday, the Obama Foundation announced the 100 recipients of this year’s Obama-Chesky Voyager Scholarship. Dormus is one of the lucky 100 students to be selected.
Dormus said when he found out, he said he “fell to the ground.”

“I was ecstatic, it was a dream come true,” he said.
The scholarship is backed by former President Barack Obama, Michelle Obama and Airbnb Co-founder & CEO, Brian Chesky. It is awarded to students who have a passion for public service, and it provides financial aid and resources for an immersive work-travel experience.
“Next summer, they will send me anywhere I want to go in the world,” Dormus said.
“We get to study something we’re passionate about, volunteer, do an internship, or just do something good in the world.”
Dormus told News 19 that he wants to use his voyage to study mental health.
“I call it 6-in-6,” he said. “Six continents in six weeks”.
“I would love to just go to each continent and study under professors and students on each continent and talk about mental health and see what’s going on around the world,” he said.
Dormus told News 19 that he struggled with his own mental health when he started college. After working through that, he’s used his own struggles to help others.
“I opened up a professionally designed mental health room to help students like me,” he said.
He said he’s thankful for the scholarship and the opportunity to continue his studies and prepare for his future career.
“I’m so thankful to be in this program, because it affords me an opportunity to give back,” he said.
